entities.summary: Teresa Berganza Vargas OAXS was a Spanish mezzo-soprano. She is most closely associated with roles such as Rossini's Rosina and La Cenerentola, and later Bizet's Carmen, admired for her technical virtuosity, musical intelligence, and beguiling stage presence. Teresa Berganza was a writers & intellectuals from Madrid (1933-03-16, Madrid–2022-05-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
